item.subject: science
item.stem:
Kavya places a compass next to a copper coil that can be switched into a closed loop with a cell.

Which statements should be true?

statements.text: When the switch is ON and the loop is complete, the compass needle should deflect.
When the switch is ON but a wire is disconnected, the needle should still deflect because the cell is present.
A resting compass, by itself, drives a steady current through the nearby coil.

learn_by_solve.solve: When a metal is put into another metal's salt solution, decide whether a displacement reaction will occur and use the result to compare reactivity.

followup.stem: Assign oxidation numbers first. The species is [[1]] if OS increases, [[2]] if OS decreases, or [[3]] if OS stays the same.
followup.why: A more reactive metal displaces a less reactive metal from its compound in solution or molten form; the reactivity series lists metals in decreasing reactivity from potassium toward gold. This is the hinge move, not a reprint of the clicked option.
